proof_review.growth: Full derivation of log value coefficients and global optimum read. proof_review.compact_control: Continuous functions on compact capacity domain, positive funded consumption, observed exogenous state, owned investment and adapted policies correctly specified. Sup contraction/Cauchy limit plus bounded terminal verification proves value for all histories. Explicit continuous clipped maximizer makes a selection theorem unnecessary. Exact basis identity holds globally, not because of two-node agreement.

Separate policy contraction and triangle inequality give conservative (2delta+eta)/(1-beta); exact policy value gives sharper delta/(1-beta). Uniform first/second action derivatives and endpoint/half-gap geometry yield linear/quadratic mesh bounds. Primitive sensitivity has same state/action domain, reward bound and row-absolute-sum convention; total variation factor two correct.
proof_review.likelihood: Fixed-origin independent one-transition panel makes ordered Bernoulli likelihood and variance calculation valid. Derivative signs establish global interior MLE and all-zero/all-one open-boundary supremum; absent origin observations leave unidentified row. Bernoulli sum variance, squared-error Markov and union bound prove finite coverage. Same count likelihood for dependent path does not license panel variance.
proof_review.identification: Stationary balance and centered conditional expectation derive mean/covariance. Full one-moment equivalent curve and feasible two-moment inverse established; redundant indicator variance adds no information. Explicit inverse gives global identification here; nonsingular local Jacobian alone is not universal global proof. Infeasible moments and open-domain nonattainment retained.
proof_review.prediction_and_welfare: Expected log score has unique interior truthful optimum; Brier decomposition proves propriety. Finite held-out ranking, zero-probability failure and postselection conditions separated from calibrated inference. Distinct utility/ownership laboratories are not interchangeable welfare metrics. Full referee rubric requires economic closure, numerical certificate, identified sampling law and honest validation.
